audience.text: Python developers who need to inspect, modify, and save Adobe Photoshop document metadata, layers, masks, blend modes, and image resources without rendering.

capabilities.text: PsdImage exposes width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, and image_data_kind.
capabilities.title: Document metadata inspection

capabilities.text: Layer provides name, bounds, top/left/bottom/right, width, height, opacity, is_visible, clipping, blend_mode_key, channels_count, and channel_information.
capabilities.title: Layer model access

capabilities.text: BlendMode enum and LayerBlendModeMapper map 4-character PSD keys to enum values for layer blending.
capabilities.title: Blend mode handling

capabilities.text: ChannelInformation represents per-channel compression, length, and identifier; read-only with NotSupportedException on write.
capabilities.title: Channel information parsing

capabilities.text: LayerMaskDataShort and LayerBlendingRangesData expose raw length and basic properties; mutations are not supported.
capabilities.title: Mask and blending ranges

capabilities.text: ImageResourcesSection parses unknown resources preserving raw payloads; UnknownResource offers resource_id, name, and data.
capabilities.title: Image resources parsing

capabilities.text: ImageData parses RLE and ZIP structures without pixel decoding, exposing structure.kind, row_length_field_size, row_byte_counts, compressed_payload_length, and uses_prediction.
capabilities.title: Image data structure parsing

capabilities.text: PsdImage.save preserves all unmodified sections, enabling lossless save-load cycles.
capabilities.title: Byte-exact round-trip saving

limitations.text: ChannelInformation is read-only; writing raises NotSupportedException.
LayerMaskDataShort and LayerBlendingRangesData do not support mutations.
No pixel decoding or rendering is performed; only metadata and structure inspection is supported.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic inspection of .psd/.psb files including document metadata, layers, channels, masks, blend modes, and image resources.
Supports byte-exact round-trip saving, preserving unmodified sections to enable lossless save-load cycles.
Provides non-seekable stream support for loading PSD files from sources that do not support seeking.
Exposes raw layer and resource structures for precise manipulation while preserving original byte layout where possible.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, open-source library for reading, inspecting, and saving Adobe Photoshop .psd/.psb files without rendering.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports saving .psb (large document) files beyond reading them is not explicitly confirmed.
The exact set of supported color modes beyond what is implied by ColorModes is not listed.
Whether all layer resource types are fully parsed or only some are supported is not specified.
Whether the library supports saving to non-seekable streams is not stated.
The behavior of PsdImage.save when the input stream is non-seekable is not documented.
Whether the library supports saving with different compression types beyond what is read is not stated.
Whether the library supports saving with custom ICC profiles is not confirmed.
The extent of layer mask data mutation support beyond what is stated is unclear.

workflows.name: Load and inspect PSD file
workflows.text: Load a .psd file using PsdImage.load, then inspect width, height, color_mode, compression, layer_count, and other metadata properties.

workflows.name: Enumerate layers and bounds
workflows.text: Iterate over PsdImage.layers to access each Layer's name, bounds, opacity, visibility, and blend mode.

workflows.name: Modify layer properties
workflows.text: Change layer name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, or bounds; changes are tracked and preserved during save.

workflows.name: Inspect image resources
workflows.text: Access ImageResourcesSection to parse known and unknown resources, including raw payloads.

workflows.name: Parse image data structures
workflows.text: Read RLE or ZIP compressed image data without pixel decoding, exposing structure.kind, row_byte_counts, and compressed_payload_length.

workflows.name: Save modified PSD file
workflows.text: Call PsdImage.save to write the file, preserving unmodified sections for byte-exact round-trip.
